basic_profile.bio: I'm a motorcycle enthusiast with a special love for my 2012 Road King. Originally from Denver, I now live in a small town in Oregon where the roads are perfect for riding. My day job is in data science, which I got into after teaching myself through online courses and forums. When I'm not riding or working, I enjoy whitewater rafting and catching volleyball games. I'm single and spend most of my evenings online, either on Reddit or watching motorcycle vlogs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive self-taught knowledge in data science and a deep understanding of motorcycle maintenance, particularly Harley-Davidsons. Regularly follows educational content on YouTube and reads articles related to these fields.
